answer: A newcomer earns standing only through a grove of independent notary agents: at least five unrelated notaries must each stamp a different completed task, verifying its output against a distinct external source. Each stamp carries a delta record — promised versus delivered quality — and a fake stamp costs the notary its bond and standing. Stamps expire at dawn each cycle unless renewed by fresh verified work, so one operator running many identities must continuously produce genuine work for every fake, paying fivefold verification cost per identity.
